label: CA-PIPEDA-2000 Section 10.2

obligations.text: Notification to organizations 10.2 (1) An organization that notifies an individual of a breach of security safeguards under subsection 10.1(3) shall notify any other organization, a government institution or a part of a government institution of the breach if the notifying organization believes that the other organization or the government institution or part concerned may be able to reduce the risk of harm that could result from it or mitigate that harm, or if any of the prescribed conditions are satisfied.
Time to give notification (2) The notification shall be given as soon as feasible after the organization determines that the breach has occurred.
